pieces.Text: Lorthact exists slightly outside of the normal timestream. Spells that predict the future-such as augury, divination, Foresight, and moment of prescience can not perceive him and provide no benefit against him or information about him. In addition, whenever a creature within 6o feet of him uses time stop, Lorthact can act normally within the duration of the time stop, as if he had cast it himself.
